name: Data.iota_goodProjTranslate_apply
summary: Expand the group algebra element and use the equivariance of ι.

steps.claim: Write |𝖦|e₀s as a sum over 𝖦 acting through the principal representation (asAlgebraHom_eq_sum), move ι past the representation (iota_principalRep: ι_ϑ of a translate is the translate by groupLift) and distribute the scalars.
steps.lean:
simp [asAlgebraHom_eq_sum, ← Module.End.mul_apply, ← map_mul, iota_principalRep, Finset.smul_sum,
    mul_smul]
